purpose: Revised 3-card candidate sample for CET4 listening box 0051 after the existing sample was blocked by agent self-review.

source_policy.source_note: Uses legacy content_pool transcripts with unverified provenance as simulated training material. Do not label as true exam content.

front.text: 听完后，选出 In summary 后总结出的核心结论。
front.task_prompt: 前一句列出讨论过的材料；In summary 后面才是最终主旨判断。

options.text: Flexible shift planning improves both staff satisfaction and store efficiency.
Customer feedback is the only factor that matters for stores.
Turnover data should replace all scheduling decisions.
Flexible shifts reduce satisfaction but increase efficiency.

task_schema.success_criteria: 能区分前文分点回顾和结尾总结句

audio.transcript: We have discussed turnover, customer feedback, and scheduling data. In summary, flexible shift planning improves both staff satisfaction and store efficiency.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 A。前一句 We have discussed turnover, customer feedback, and scheduling data 是分点回顾；In summary 标志说话人进入结论。结论里有两个并列结果：staff satisfaction 和 store efficiency 都得到提升。B 把一个材料夸大成唯一因素，C 把 data 误读成替代方案，D 把 improves 改成一升一降。
tips: In summary 后面通常是主旨结论。
结尾总结题要保留并列结果，不能漏掉一半。
前文列举项常是证据，不一定是最终答案。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 In summary 后的结尾总括结论

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户在听力结尾处快速抓住总结信号，避免把前文分点误当主旨。

front.text: 听完后，选出 Overall 后给出的最终主旨。
front.task_prompt: 先把 salary、workload、support 识别为前文回顾项，再听 Overall 后说话人怎样给出最终评价结论。

options.text: Teacher salaries should double in every district.
Digital tools can replace classroom support.
Local mentoring is the most effective way to retain new teachers.
Education policy history is the main topic.

task_schema.success_criteria: 能选出覆盖结尾总判断的主题项，而不是局部回顾项

audio.transcript: We reviewed salary, workload, and classroom support. Overall, mentoring at the local level is the most effective way to keep new teachers in the profession.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 C。We reviewed salary, workload, and classroom support 是前文议题回顾；Overall 后面才给出总判断。most effective way 表示结尾结论的评价强度，keep new teachers in the profession 对应 retain new teachers。A 只抓 salary 并加入 double，B 换成 digital tools，D 无中生有。
tips: Overall 常把前文多个因素收束成最终判断。
most effective way 是结论强度信号。
选项可以同义改写，但不能新增绝对化条件。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 根据 Overall 识别结尾总括评价结论

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 帮助用户把结尾总结句中的评价强度和对象关系转化为稳定的主旨选择。

front.text: 听完后，选出 To sum up 后总结出的最终结论。
front.task_prompt: 前半句是短期结果和困难；To sum up 后面才是长期收益的总括。

options.text: All pilot cities achieved strong short-term results immediately.
Some teams struggled, so the training program should stop.
Long-term investment in frontline training produced the strongest overall gains.
Short-term city comparisons were more important than training.

task_schema.action: 四选一：总结触发句匹配
task_schema.focus: To sum up / strongest overall gains
task_schema.success_criteria: 能过滤铺垫中的短期混合结果，选出结尾的长期总结

audio.transcript: The pilot cities showed mixed short-term outcomes, and some teams struggled at first. To sum up, long-term investment in frontline training produced the strongest overall gains.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 C。前半句说明 pilot cities 的短期结果并不一致，一些团队最初也遇到困难；To sum up 标志进入总结，真正的结论是长期投入 frontline training 带来 strongest overall gains。A 把 mixed 改成全都成功，B 从困难跳到停止项目，D 把短期比较抬高为主旨，均与总结句相反。
tips: To sum up 后面通常是最后答案区。
短期困难可能只是铺垫，不等于最终态度。
结尾总结题要优先保留 long-term、overall 这类范围词。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 To sum up 后的长期总括结论
